title: Jumpstart: Historic Horizons: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Every little cub has its mother's teeth to guard it. —Elvish saying
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power." —Jolrael, empress of beasts
A spike and a maul are needed to crack their shells, but the taste is worth the effort.
